ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java var queryParams = attributes.queryParams var propertyType = queryParams.propertyType var status = queryParams.status var lastModifiedFrom = queryParams.lastModifiedFrom var limit = queryParams.limit default 100 var offset = queryParams.offset default 0 --- { propertyType: propertyType, status: status, lastModifiedFrom: lastModifiedFrom, limit: limit, offset: offset }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var queryParams = attributes.queryParams --- { propertyType: queryParams.propertyType, status: queryParams.status, lastModifiedFrom: queryParams.lastModifiedFrom }

db:select.db:sql: SELECT p.PROPERTY_ID as propertyId, p.PROPERTY_TYPE as propertyType, p.STREET as street, p.CITY as city, p.STATE as state, p.POSTAL_CODE as postalCode, p.COUNTRY as country, p.CURRENT_VALUE as currentValue, p.CURRENCY as currency, p.VALUATION_DATE as valuationDate, p.VALUATION_METHOD as valuationMethod, p.OWNER_ID as ownerId, p.OWNER_NAME as ownerName, p.OWNERSHIP_TYPE as ownershipType, p.ACQUISITION_DATE as acquisitionDate, p.STATUS as status, p.CREATED_DATE as createdDate, p.LAST_MODIFIED_DATE as lastModifiedDate, p.SOURCE as source FROM MDM_REAL_ESTATE_PROPERTIES p WHERE 1=1 AND (:propertyType IS NULL OR p.PROPERTY_TYPE = :propertyType) AND (:status IS NULL OR p.STATUS = :status) AND (:lastModifiedFrom IS NULL OR p.LAST_MODIFIED_DATE >= TO_DATE(:lastModifiedFrom, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS')) ORDER BY p.LAST_MODIFIED_DATE DESC OFFSET :offset ROWS FETCH NEXT :limit ROWS ONLY
db:select.db:input-parameters: #[{ propertyType: payload.propertyType, status: payload.status, lastModifiedFrom: payload.lastModifiedFrom, limit: payload.limit, offset: payload.offset }]

db:select.db:sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount FROM MDM_REAL_ESTATE_PROPERTIES p WHERE 1=1 AND (:propertyType IS NULL OR p.PROPERTY_TYPE = :propertyType) AND (:status IS NULL OR p.STATUS = :status) AND (:lastModifiedFrom IS NULL OR p.LAST_MODIFIED_DATE >= TO_DATE(:lastModifiedFrom, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'))

SELECT p.PROPERTY_ID as propertyId, p.PROPERTY_TYPE as propertyType, p.STREET as street, p.CITY as city, p.STATE as state, p.POSTAL_CODE as postalCode, p.COUNTRY as country, p.CURRENT_VALUE as currentValue, p.CURRENCY as currency, p.VALUATION_DATE as valuationDate, p.VALUATION_METHOD as valuationMethod, p.OWNER_ID as ownerId, p.OWNER_NAME as ownerName, p.OWNERSHIP_TYPE as ownershipType, p.ACQUISITION_DATE as acquisitionDate, p.STATUS as status, p.CREATED_DATE as createdDate, p.LAST_MODIFIED_DATE as lastModifiedDate, p.SOURCE as source FROM MDM_REAL_ESTATE_PROPERTIES p WHERE p.PROPERTY_ID = :propertyId

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { code: "NOT_FOUND", message: "Property with ID $(vars.propertyId) not found", correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }

%dw 2.0 output application/json var property = payload[0] --- { propertyId: property.propertyId, propertyType: property.propertyType, address: { street: property.street, city: property.city, state: property.state, postalCode: property.postalCode, country: property.country }, valuation: { currentValue: property.currentValue, currency: property.currency, valuationDate: property.valuationDate, valuationMethod: property.valuationMethod }, ownership: { ownerId: property.ownerId, ownerName: property.ownerName, ownershipType: property.ownershipType, acquisitionDate: property.acquisitionDate }, status: property.status, createdDate: property.createdDate, lastModifiedDate: property.lastModifiedDate, source: property.source }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "UP", timestamp: now(), application: p('app.name'), environment: p('env') }
